title: kith-events tests use stale 'Contact' type_name fixture
description: crates/kith-events/src/lib.rs lines 64 and 106 use type_name: "Contact" in test fixtures. The production store emits "ChatContact" (contact.rs:23). The channel-mechanics tests pass because they never assert on type_name, but the fixture string is now wrong and will mislead future readers. Should be updated to "ChatContact" to match the actual emitted value.
